visual_elements.description: 3D coordinate system with vertical red axis labeled 'y' and two horizontal axes labeled 'x1' (lower left) and 'x2' (right). A tilted yellow parallelogram plane labeled 'W' (underlined) cuts through the space. On/around the plane are data points: red points and blue points, with tick labels '1' and '2' on the x1 and x2 axes. Red curved annotation '-ve ( < 0 )' with a red arrow pointing to one side of the plane; blue annotation '+ve ( > 0 )' with a blue arrow pointing to the other side.

Matrix equation: rows labeled x1, x2, x3, x4 each followed by '⇒' and a row of a 4x3 matrix: row1 '1 1 1', row2 '1 2 2', row3 '1 2 1', row4 '1 1 2'; multiplied by column vector ( W ) in red, equals a column vector of inequalities: '> 0', '< 0', '> 0', '< 0' (the >0 entries in red, <0 entries in blue).
Footer banner with the question 'How to deal “Mathematically” with “<” and “>” ???' where 'Mathematically' is in red and the rest in black.
Yellow circle containing slide number '31' in dark text.
